description: AT Protocol counterpart of an Adherent SBT mint event on Base L2. The SBT is a non-transferable ERC-721 minted to a member's Smart Account when one of three trigger conditions is met (per ADR-2605192100 §1.16 + ADR-2605192300): a first donation, an explicit Charter Affirmation, or a Council-granted bootstrap mint. This record carries the trigger reference, the on-chain mint transaction hash, and the hash of the Charter Affirmation message the member signed. Constitutional: 1 SBT = 1 vote (no tiers), non-transferable, voluntary withdrawal permitted via `com.etzhayyim.member.withdrawal` (not yet authored — surfaced gap).

memberDid.description: DID of the member receiving the Adherent SBT. Per `FORK-BOOTSTRAP.md` constitutional invariant #2, member must operate a religious DID.

tokenId.description: Base L2 Adherent SBT ERC-721 token ID (unsigned, unitless serial integer; minimum 1 — token 0 is reserved per OpenZeppelin convention).

mintTxHash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte transaction hash of the AdherentSBT.mint() call. Prefix `0x`, lowercase.

trigger.description: What caused the SBT to be minted. Single value, lowercase, hyphenated.

triggerRef.description: Optional AT URI of the triggering record: if `first-donation`, the AT URI of the `com.etzhayyim.give.usdc.donation` or `com.etzhayyim.give.land.donation` record; if `council-grant`, the AT URI of the Council proposal authorizing the grant.

affirmationHashOnchain.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the plaintext Charter Affirmation message the member signed with their DID key. The plaintext is stored separately as `com.etzhayyim.member.charter-affirmation` (not yet authored — surfaced gap). Prefix `0x`, lowercase.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at the moment of SBT mint observation.
